title.narrative: Accelerating Transport and Trade Connectivity in Eastern South Asia Phase 2 - Bhutan Project

description.narrative: The development objective is to increase the efficiency and resilience of trade and transport along selected corridors in Bhutan.

The development objective of the Second Phase of Accelerating Transport and Trade Connectivity in Eastern South Asia Project for Bhutan is to increase the efficiency and resilience of trade and transport along selected regional corridors in eastern South Asia. This project has three components. The first component, Digital Systems for Trade, has the following sub-components: Implementation of National Single Window (NSW) for Trade; Strengthening Digital Enablers; Enhancing Cybersecurity; and Improving Digital Connectivity and Data Infrastructure Resilience. The second component, Green and Resilient Transport and Trade Infrastructure, has the following sub-components: Developing Green, Resilient, and Safe Road Connectivity; Strengthening Road Asset Management and Maintenance; and Improving Multimodal Connectivity. The third component, Institutional and Policy Strengthening for Transport and Trade, has the following sub-components: Project Implementation Support and Capacity Building to Implementing Agencies; : Policy and Regulatory Support; and Resilient and Sustainable Regional Infrastructure Planning Support.
